response.answer: The drop is concentrated almost entirely in debit card payments issued by Harbor Bank. Across all four acquirers, Harbor Bank's success rate fell from about 86% (10-20 Oct) to roughly 73-75% (21-31 Oct): Kestrel 86.0% to 75.5%, Meridian 85.6% to 73.5%, Northstar 85.9% to 75.2%, Saffron 86.0% to 74.0%. Harbor failures rose from 844 to 1,918 on only modestly higher volume (5,975 to 7,536 attempts). Because the decline hits every acquirer equally, the cause looks issuer-side (Harbor Bank declines) rather than a problem with any one acquirer. Other issuers (Banyan, Coral, Indigo, Lotus, Ridge) moved only about 0-3 points in either direction, with a few small dips such as Coral/Northstar 84.7% to 82.1% and Lotus/Northstar 85.6% to 83.1%, which are minor by comparison. Note: this shows where the drop occurred, not why Harbor Bank declined more; failure reason/decline codes would be needed to pin down the root cause.
